messages:
incident_bot: PAGED net-1 oncall (P1) — Customer GreenHarbor (Private VPC, dedicated pool) reporting app errors: large spike in 502/503s from ingress NLB to tenants. Auto-attach: https://redwood.incidents/2464123000

oncall_dataplane: ack — I'm on it, joining channel. grabbing runbook and customer VPC details.

morgan: seeing same in SLO dash, 5xx rate ~28% on greenharbor-prod route, started ~07:12 UTC. Latency up as well.

devon: adding logs from ember-proxy: ```504 upstream read timeout from 10.1.42.7:8080
at timeout at 120s```

net_eng_lee: initial read — NLB target group shows unhealthy instances in us-west-2a only, health checks failing with 504 from targets. ALB in front reports 503 backend unavailable for path /api/v1/tenants/gh-*/

sasha: confirm customer reported they pushed a security group change ~07:05 local time (via their infra team). Could be related. Customer says they only opened a single cidr but might've overridden the ALB healthcheck SG.

support_nina: customer_ops_jules on call from GreenHarbor — they confirm they changed SG to tighten ingress, didn't realize healthcheck IPs were caller-managed. Asking for immediate mitigation — their downstream app is user-facing.

oncall_dataplane: ok step 1: check NLB health and target SGs, then quick mitigation: add temporary SG allow for healthcheck range and re-register targets. I can run the change if we get customer approval.

morgan: grabbing current SG rule set: ```sg-0a1b2c3d: ingress TCP 80 from 10.0.0.0/8
sg-0d3c2b1a: ingress TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0``` — healthcheck IPs not present.

devon: reproduction: curl to NLB health endpoint from control-plane elb host times out. Also see lots of 502s in the proxy logs when hitting tenant GH-203.

ops_bot: Audit note: customer-managed SG change detected at 2464122850 by greenharbor-admin via Terraform apply.

oncall_dataplane: contacting customer_ops_jules for explicit temporary allow. Jules? confirm we can open SG from healthcheck CIDR 10.11.12.0/24 for 10 minutes.

customer_ops_jules: yes, we authorize. Please add temporary rule and tell us when to remove.

oncall_dataplane: applying temporary SG rule now. command: ```aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.11.12.0/24 --description "temp-redwood-healthchecks-2464123000"```

morgan: saw targets recover in target-group within ~30s — health checks passing back in 2/3 AZs. 503 rate down to 6% and falling.

net_eng_lee: note — one target still flapping (i-0f12ab3c) in us-west-2a. I'm going to cordon it out of the pool and let autoscaling replace. Marking for replacement.

devon: rolling restart of proxy pod on greenharbor-dedicated-02 to clear any stuck connections. ```kubectl -n gh-prod rollout restart deployment/ember-proxy```

oncall_dataplane: after restart and SG change, error rate dropped to <1% at 07:25 UTC. Customer reports application responsiveness restored.

sasha: what's root cause hypothesis? customer-managed SG removed ALB/NLB healthcheck IPs, causing health failures and backend churn. One instance also had a stale conntrack leading to 5xx until restarted.

support_nina: customer impact: about 13 minutes of degraded service for a subset of tenants (tenant shard GH-2 and GH-3). Impacted ~4200 sessions, primarily GET/POST to /api. No data loss reported.

morgan: adding quick timeline: 
- 07:05 UTC: customer applied SG tightening
- 07:12 UTC: on-call paged for increased 5xx
- 07:14 UTC: investigation shows healthcheck fails
- 07:18 UTC: temporary SG rule applied
- 07:20 UTC: targets recover, restarts begin
- 07:25 UTC: error rates back to baseline

oncall_dataplane: doing handoff to day SRE and networking for postmortem and customer follow-up. I'll leave a note in runbook and set reminder to remove temp rule at 08:00 UTC if customer hasn't removed it.

ops_bot: Scheduled cleanup: will revoke rule in 35 minutes unless marked safe.

net_eng_lee: create follow-up ticket to validate healthcheck automation won't be user-managed in next deployments and add guardrails. I'll link to the greenharbor infra docs.

customer_ops_jules: appreciate the fast help. we'll update our terraform to preserve healthcheck ranges and notify infra owners.

sasha: post-incident actions: 
- customer engineering to update SG IaC (owner: GreenHarbor)
- Redwood: add a tenant onboarding checklist item and an alert on customer-managed SG changes for private VPCs (owner: net_eng_lee)
- run a review of conntrack tuning on dedicated pools (owner: devon)

morgan: tagging incident as P1 -> mitigated. Creating summary for PSR. Will include logs/snippets and the runbook steps used.

oncall_dataplane: final note: temporary SG rule description and manual cleanup tracked in ticket #INC-6421. Leaving channel — handoff complete.

incident_bot: Incident 2464123000 status: mitigated. Notify: #postmortems and #customer-success for follow-up.

support_nina: I'll coordinate a customer-facing postmortem with GreenHarbor for tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

morgan: thanks everyone.

oncall_dataplane: out.
